title: Scan grammar length bound
statement: Let $F$ be a machine format, and let $\alpha$, $b$, $r$, and $u$ be finite bit strings. If parsing $\alpha$ yields the pair $(b,r)$, and scanning $\alpha$ with format $F$ succeeds with remaining suffix $u$, then $(4k+5)3^{k+1}(\operatorname{val}(b)+1)\le |r|$, where $k$ is the parameter of $F$ and $\operatorname{val}(b)$ is the natural number represented by $b$ in least-significant-bit-first binary.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a machine format with parameter $k$
